basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old sound engineer and hobbyist synthesizer enthusiast from Manchester, UK. Passionate about creating electronic music and loves diving into the technical aspects of sound design. Dislikes overly commercial music and prefers indie and avant-garde scenes. Often online during late evenings and weekends, balancing online activity with a full-time job in audio post-production. Enjoys birdwatching in local parks, which complements an interest in ornithology. In a committed relationship, shares a flat with a partner who is a graphic designer.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in synthesizer programming, with a formal education in audio engineering. Regularly attends workshops and online courses to stay updated with the latest in sound technology. Has a deep interest in ornithology, inspired by childhood birdwatching trips with family.
